start.text: It's contained. The attack has stopped, but now we have to find out what it touched.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work, Joshua. I watched the whole fight. But stopping an attack is not the same as fixing the damage.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Anything they touched is still broken, or still open to them. We can't let people go back to work like that.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: Walk through the office and look for machines marked with a [b][color=red]![/color][/b]. Those are the ones the attacker got to.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: Not yet. Her password has to change, and the thief has to be signed out. Otherwise they can walk right back in.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: Fix one thing at a time. When everything is repaired, we run a [b][color=green]final check[/color][/b] before anyone gets back to work.
D.name: Carla

E.text: Got it. Clean up first, then check. I don't want Anna to be scared again.
E.name: Joshua
